title: Overlord_guardian
description: want more difficulty? more mobs? this datapack has it all plus a designated guardian that can be every mob!
body:
# 🛡️ OVERLORD_GUARDIAN V2.0 **General Description** Overlord is a Vanilla modification (Datapack) designed for Paper 1.21.4 servers, introducing an advanced loyal companion system ("Guardians") and rebalancing game difficulty through a "Horde" system featuring elite enemy variants. ## 1\. GUARDIAN SYSTEM This module allows nearly any hostile entity to be recruited into a permanent, loyal bodyguard. ### 🔹 Universal Recruitment * **Method:** Using a **Name Tag** renamed to `Guardian` on the target entity. * You also most join the 'Guardianes' team, otherwise they may still atack you. * **Compatibility:** Works on Zombies, Skeletons, Witches, Illagers (Pillagers/Vindicators), Blazes, Spiders, etc. * **Identification:** Recruited Guardians display a permanent **glowing** blue outline to distinguish them from enemies. ### 🔹 "Tank" Attributes Once transformed, the unit receives massive enhancements to ensure survivability: * **Health:** 240 HP (120 Hearts). * **Environmental Immunities:** Full resistance to Fire, Lava, Drowning, and Fall Damage. * **Sunlight Resistance:** Undead mobs (Zombies/Skeletons) no longer burn in daylight. * **Healing Factor:** Passive health regeneration after 5 seconds out of combat. ### 🔹 AI Behavior * **Smart Targeting:** Guardians actively attack hostile monsters but strictly ignore: * Players on the security team. * Pets (Wolves, Cats, Parrots). * Villagers and Iron Golems. * Allied Guardians. * **Tactical Aggression:** Uses a periodic "Taunt" system that forces nearby enemies to focus on the Guardian instead of the player. ----- ## 2\. COMMAND SYSTEM Unit control is handled via interactions with common items—no chat commands required. | Item | Action | Mechanical Effect | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Gold Nugget** | Throw (Q) nearby | **Medical Supplies:** Instantly restores unit health. | | **Magma Cream** | Throw (Q) nearby | **Tactical Order Switch:**
1. **Escort Mode:** Unit follows the player (default behavior).
2. **Sentinel Mode:** Unit remains stationary at its current position with increased resistance (ideal for guarding entrances). | | **Blaze Rod** | Crouch (Shift) while holding it | **Emergency Call:** Instantly teleports all Guardians in "Escort Mode" to the player’s location. | | **Bed** | Proximity | **Honor Guard:** If a Guardian detects a nearby bed, it automatically enters static defensive mode (Sentinel). | ----- ## 3\. THE BESTIARY To counterbalance Guardian power, the system modifies hostile mob spawning. Each time an enemy spawns, the system determines its variant: ### 🔴 The "Nightmare" Horde Enhanced versions of base mobs. * **Upgrades:** +40% movement speed and +8 extra Hearts of health. * **Purpose:** Prevents enemies from becoming trivial in the face of Guardian strength. ### 🟣 "Mythic" Elites Rare variants equipped with custom gear and stats, acting as mini-bosses. #### **Zombie Variants:** 1. **Titan:** Giant-sized (Scale 1.2), extremely slow, wears heavy armor, and wields a massive axe for high damage. 2. **Berserker:** Increased speed, no armor, wields an enchanted Golden Sword—delivers rapid, high DPS. #### **Skeleton Variants:** 1. **Sniper:** Invisible and stationary, equipped with a high-power bow (Power IV). 2. **Vanguard:** Heavy infantry unit with full chainmail armor and a rapid-fire crossbow. #### **Creeper Variants:** 1. **Nuke:** Giant, charged (electric) Creeper. Large explosion radius, slow movement. 2. **Ghost:** Fully invisible and silent, but detonates quickly with a small blast radius. #### **Spider Variants:** 1. **Goliath:** Giant spider (Scale 1.5), with increased health and damage. 2. **Weaver:** Tiny spider (Scale 0.6), with extreme speed and high evasion difficulty. ----- ### Compatibility Summary * **Version:** Paper/Spigot 1.21.4. * **Requirements:** None (100% Vanilla-compatible via Datapacks). * **Conflicts:** Designed to override external plugin AI when necessary, ensuring Guardian loyalty at all times.
